messages:
asha: PTAL — addressed comments from @sam and @lee. Changed KV eviction logic per suggestions, added unit tests for eviction edge cases, and updated perf numbers in README (local: 2400 rps -> 2100 rps with new batching). Rebased onto main and force-pushed: `git push --force-with-lease origin asha/kv-evict-fix`

sam: thanks — looking now. quick request: can you squash the fixup commits into two logical commits? makes history nicer for backfills. :thumbsup:

lee: nice cleanup. left a tiny inline comment about a potential concurrency window at kv_cache.py:244 (possible race on _cache_notifier). not blocking, but please double-check. also can you add a tiny e2e script so QA can reproduce the scenario?

ci-bot: Build #4523 — tests failed (flake8): `./python/kv_cache.py:244:1: F401 'typing' imported but unused`

asha: doh, thanks ci-bot. removed unused import, adjusted the notifier logic per lee's comment, added tests for overlap case, and added tools/e2e_kv.sh (bash) to exercise the eviction path. Squashed commits into two: "kv: fix eviction race + tests (JIRA-1234)" and "tools: add e2e_kv.sh". Pushed. PTAL again.

maria: I'll run the e2e locally this afternoon and report back. ping me when CI is green and I'll sanity-check results.

sam: LGTM pending CI green and commit message includes the ticket. can you make sure the first commit message references JIRA-1234? then I can approve.

asha: updated commit message to include JIRA-1234 in the first commit, re-pushed (`git push --force-with-lease`).

ci-bot: Build #4526 — all checks passed ✅

sam: approved — merging now. I'll do a light canary tomorrow morning and watch the latency dashboard. thanks!

asha: thanks everyone :raised_hands: will follow up in the morning if any canary issues show up.
